estfc.config.title: Ecliptic Seasons TFC Compat Configuration
estfc.config.resetConfirm.message: All settings will be reset to defaults.
estfc.config.tfcLeavesSnowBlocks.tooltip:
Blocks that use leaf snow effect (dual-layer: top snow + internal spots).
Supports path prefix, full ID, and regex formats.
Changes take effect after F3+T resource reload.
Default: regex:plant/.*_leaves (TFC fruit tree leaves)
estfc.config.tfcConnectedTexture.tooltip:
Enable TFC connected textures (smooth transitions on grass/dirt etc.).
⚠ When enabled, ConnectedGrassBlock will not have snow.
Default: false (disabled, ensures snow works properly)
estfc.config.snowAppearanceTemp.tooltip:
Snow appearance temperature (°C): above this → no snow.
Between this and the full-coverage temperature the coverage ramps
linearly (e.g. -1°C→25%, -2°C→50%, -3°C→75% with defaults).
Default: 0.0
estfc.config.snowFullCoverageTemp.toolti:
Full snow coverage temperature (°C): below this → 100% snow.
The gap to snowAppearanceTemp sets the transition band width (default 0~-4°C).
Default: -4.0
estfc.config.snowMeltTemp.tooltip:
Snow melt temperature (°C): above this snow melts, below this +
precipitation it accumulates. Should match snowAppearanceTemp.
Default: 0.0
estfc.config.snowRainfallNoSnow.tooltip:
Annual rainfall below this (mm/year) → no snow at all
(deserts and other arid regions).
Default: 80
estfc.config.snowRainfallFullSnow.toolti:
Annual rainfall above this (mm/year) → snow not reduced by rainfall.
Between the two thresholds coverage ramps linearly (e.g. 115mm → 50%).
Default: 150
estfc.config.dhTempPrefetchRadius.toolti:
[DH/voxy] Prefetch radius (blocks) of region climate points (128-block grid,
temperature + surface height). Region points are generated server-side
deterministically from the world seed and synced to the client; this radius
bounds the prefetch area around the player.
Distant temperature = avgSeaLevelTemp + monthly term ± regional elevation.
Default: 1024
estfc.config.dhTempRequestsPerTick.toolt:
[DH/voxy] Maximum region-point requests sent per tick (client).
First-bake happens 1-2s after world load; a low rate leaves distant
snow missing until region data arrives.
Default: 512
estfc.config.dhTempServerThreads.tooltip:
[DH/voxy] Server worker threads for region climate point computation (async).
Computation (TFC noise sampling / region generation) runs on a separate
thread pool, not blocking the main thread.
Actual thread count = min(this value, available processors).
Default: 4
estfc.config.dhTempServerSubmitPerTick.t:
[DH/voxy] Region points submitted to the server computation pool per tick.
First-bake prefetches ~81 points; 64/tick submits them all in 1-2 ticks.
Default: 64
estfc.config.voxyPeriodicRefresh.tooltip:
[voxy] Periodically refresh voxy distant snow (default on).
Voxy LOD snow is decided at ingest and frozen; without re-ingest it never
follows temperature/season. When on, estfc calls voxy's built-in refresh
(SeasonalSnowRefresher) at a fixed interval - a background, low-priority
store walk; skips while one is already running.
For voxy forks with built-in ES compat (voxy-NHblock714).
Default: true
estfc.config.voxyPeriodicRefreshCompatVo:
[voxy] Periodic refresh for the ES-voxy-compact compat-mod version (default off).
The compat mod already refreshes on ES snow-change events; enabling this
adds estfc's timer on top and may refresh too often - off by default.
Default: false
estfc.config.tickChunkIntervalTicks.tool:
Processing interval (in ticks) for tickChunk + biomeDepth.
Affects snow accumulation/melting speed and performance.
Every N ticks: tickChunk processing + biomeDepth±1.
Default: 10 ticks
estfc.config.biomeSyncIntervalTicks.tool:
Interval (in ticks) for syncing biome snow depth from server to client.
Default: 100 (5 seconds)
estfc.config.snowTextureSimpleMode.toolt:
When enabled, uses the vanilla snow texture (minecraft:block/snow,
overridable by resource packs) uniformly for all TFC blocks.
When disabled, distinguishes textures by block type.
Default: false
estfc.config.snowTextureReplaceMode.tool:
When enabled, ES replaces the original block model with this model (instead of overlay rendering).
When disabled, uses ES's overlay mode (may cause double-layer textures).
Default: true
estfc.config.tfcSnowBlockPrefixes.toolti:
List of TFC block matches (comma separated).
Supports three formats:
  plant/ → path prefix match
  tfc:plant/plum_leaves → full ID match
  regex:plant/.*_leaves → regex match
estfc.config.tfcSimpleSnowBlocks.tooltip:
List of blocks using simple snow mode (comma separated).
These blocks use the snow.png texture uniformly on all faces.
Formats same as above: path prefix, full ID, regex.
